pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tooltip pattern, with WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus.

aria.value: id of the tooltip, added to existing ids (relation 'description')
id of the tooltip, added to existing ids (relation 'label')

keyboard.context: Focus moves to the trigger (keyboard focus-visible)

keyboard.action: Hides the tooltip without moving focus; the key is consumed.
Not handled; reaches enclosing overlays and the page.

focus: The tooltip is never focusable and never moves focus. It shows on keyboard focus (:focus-visible) of the trigger, not on pointer focus.
notes: 1.4.13 dismissible: Escape hides it without moving pointer or focus.
1.4.13 hoverable: moving the pointer from the trigger onto the tooltip keeps it open (hideDelay grace period).
1.4.13 persistent: stays visible while the trigger is hovered or focused, until Escape or another tooltip opens.
Only one tooltip is visible at a time.
Touch pointers do not show tooltips; tooltips must never hold essential information.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
